items.quote: The College may, however, determine that another process is more appropriate in the circumstances.
items.section: Policy POLICY application, scope, and limits
items.reason: The policy allows the college to determine that another process is more appropriate, making its coverage permissive.
The policy does not commit to being publicly available or posted on the website.

items.quote: A Student who has experienced Sexual Violence may make a Report by contacting a Student Support Manager in the Office of Student Support, Student Affairs. A Report may be made in writing by e-mail or letter or in-person to the Office of Student Support.
items.section: Policy Reporting Sexual Violence to the College
items.reason: The policy sets out clear, specific, and enforceable steps to report, including contact details and the next steps.

items.quote: The College will not subject individuals to questions regarding their past sexual history.
items.section: Policy Commitments to Support and Academic Consideration
items.reason: The policy explicitly and bindingly prohibits questioning individuals about their past sexual history.
The policy does not guarantee protection from face-to-face contact or direct cross-examination during proceedings.

items.quote: A person experiencing Sexual Violence has the right to determine what, when and how much they choose to disclose about an experience of Sexual Violence.
items.section: Policy Commitments to Support and Academic Consideration
items.reason: The policy protects the survivor's right to choose what to disclose, but does not explicitly address non-disclosure agreements or gag orders.

items.quote: A person experiencing Sexual Violence has the right to decide whether to make a Disclosure or Report to College or Report to Police.
items.section: Policy Commitments to Support and Academic Consideration
items.reason: The policy guarantees the survivor's right to choose between institutional and external reporting processes.

items.quote: Any person who makes a Disclosure or Report of Sexual Violence will not subject to disciplinary action for any alcohol or substance use that occurred at or near the time of the incident(s).
items.section: Policy Commitments to Support and Academic Consideration
items.reason: The policy commits in binding language to drug and alcohol amnesty for individuals who disclose or report.

items.quote: The College will endeavor to have Investigations concluded in 60 days from time the investigator receives a Report.
items.reason: The timeline is slower than the 45-day benchmark and uses permissive language.

items.quote: The College may impose a no contact direction or require a No Contact Undertaking to facilitate the provision of interim measures of support.
items.section: Policy Commitments to Support and Academic Consideration
items.reason: Interim measures are discretionary and described using permissive language.

items.quote: This Policy applies to Sexual Violence that is alleged to have occurred at any Camosun location, to have a real or substantial connection to the College, to have occurred during online College activities or at College-related functions, whether or not on College property.
items.section: Policy POLICY application, scope, and limits
items.reason: Off-campus activities are covered in general terms without explicitly naming co-ops, internships, or work placements.

items.quote: Camosun supports the right of Complainants and Respondents to be informed of processes and decisions relating to Reports, Investigations and Outcomes, except where precluded by law.
items.reason: Informing the complainant of the outcome is framed as supporting a right rather than a binding obligation, and reasons are provided only where possible.

items.quote: The Office of Student Support will make an annual update available to the College Community.
items.reason: The policy commits to an annual update but is vague about publishing specific numbers of disclosures, reports, and outcomes.

items.quote: The College will consult with students every three years regarding the implementation, application and review of this Policy.
items.reason: The review cycle is set to three years, which is longer than the two-year benchmark.
The policy does not address student representation percentages on review committees.

items.quote: The Investigation and decision-making process will be conducted using a trauma informed approach, recognizing the impact of sexual violence on a person.
items.reason: The policy states the process will be trauma-informed but does not explicitly mandate trauma-informed training for decision-makers.

items.quote: The College will establish education, training and awareness opportunities for the College Community regarding Sexual Violence Policies and Procedures, prevention and response.
items.reason: The college commits in binding language to providing prevention education and training opportunities for the college community.
